author: RLovering
body:
Hi Pascale

MFAP4 is annotated to the BP elastic fiber assembly, which is shown in figure 5 of this paper. And Fig 6 confirms that MFAP4 is associated with fibrillin-1 and co-localises with fibrillin-1 in microfibrils.
MFAP4 is annotated to both microfibril and elastic fiber, and microfibril is a child term to elastic fiber. These annotations have different AEs as I was obviously being too pedantic.

Should I just change these to colocalizes_with? 

Best

Ruth

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @RLovering 
A general point: If the gene participates in assembly, it should not be part of the complex. 

As to the distinction between microfibril and elastic fiber, I will let @DaiqingChen answer. 

Thanks, Pascale

Hi Ruth sorry it took me some time to get back. Yes, MFAP4 is found in microfibrils, and by nature will be also annotated to elastic fiber. We would like to capture the annotation in a more granular level thus proposing to delete MFAP4 from directly annotated to Elastic fiber. 

Thank you!
